主要内容: On March 20, 2013, Nicholas Financial, Inc. announced that its Board of Directors had retained Janney Montgomery Scott LLC as its independent financial advisor to evaluate possible strategic alternatives, including the potential sale of the company or its assets, acquisition opportunities, and debt or equity financing. The company also received an unsolicited, non-binding indication of interest from a third-party acquirer. This information is included in the attached press release and is not considered filed under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 unless specifically incorporated into another filing. The statements made are forward-looking and subject to risks and uncertainties. This document is a Form 8-K filing by Nicholas Financial, Inc., dated March 20, 2013. The filing includes a press release dated March 20, 2013, and outlines the company's forward-looking statements. The company cautions investors that these statements are not guarantees of future performance and involve risks and uncertainties. The company assumes no obligation to update any such statements. The filing also includes the signatures of the company's executives, including Peter L. Vosotas and Ralph T. Finkenbrink.
